title: Leaves little blue fuzzies all over you
text: Leaves little blue fuzzies all over you. After my shower I'll use one of these and it covers me in little blue fuzzies! They'll be all over my face too and I have to get another towel just to get them off my face! Just terrible! Other than that they're fluffy and soft though. Wouldn't buy again.
